latestVersion.changelog:
BGsub 1.0.0 — Initial release providing a comprehensive toolkit for X-ray diffraction (SAXS/WAXS/XRD) background subtraction in both 2D images and 1D curves.

- Self-contained CLI scripts for background subtraction and file format conversion; no external BGsub package installation required.
- Supports 2D detector image processing (TIFF/EDF/H5) and 1D curve processing (XY/DAT/CSV), including SSRF ionchamber transmission correction.
- Multiple processing methods: reference-based, algorithmic estimation (morphological/polynomial/rolling ball), and batch operations.
- Handles transmission correction automatically from ionchamber files or by manual input.
- Includes quick-start instructions and details for supported input formats and file matching.
